_comment: S3 lifecycle policy for the RESTRICTED bucket (MEDIA_S3_BUCKET_RESTRICTED).
Purpose: hard backstop for RA 10173 §11 data minimization (US-SEC4).
The purge_expired_documents management command (run nightly via cron) is the
primary enforcer — it deletes the S3 object AND nulls verification_document.file_url
90 days after a terminal verification decision (DOCUMENT_RETENTION_DAYS = 90).
This lifecycle rule is a safety net for the case where the cron never ran.
